open_points.subject: agent direct service access and personal-data disclosure
open_points.text: “the kernel neither gives nor checks it, and its personal-data promise (K-14) covers what the kernel itself returns” contradicts “Personal data — values of class `personal_data` (K-14) reach an agent only as digest and class; the owner alone reads them” and A07’s “no agent ever holds it.”
open_points.question: Does the personal-data restriction apply only to values returned through the kernel surface, or must it also constrain an agent’s direct access to a microservice?
options: The restriction applies only to kernel responses; direct service access is outside it.
Services must also prevent agents from receiving personal-data content directly.
Agents may access services directly only for values below `personal_data`.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the restriction as applying only to kernel responses, because the changed exclusion expressly limits K-14 to what the kernel returns.
